overview:
**Low fire danger continues today, with dry fuels and seasonally mild, sunny weather keeping conditions quiet across the Montrose high-elevation area.**
- Danger holds at Low through midweek before edging up to Moderate by Saturday, Nov. 14, as ERC/BI percentiles creep toward the low-50s.
- Sunny, calm days (highs near 54–56°F, winds under 5 mph) and cold, dry nights are today's main drivers, per the National Weather Service.
- None of the 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met, and no Red Flag Warning is active for the area.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions have been lifted across the BLM Uncompahgre and Gunnison Field Offices, and the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests have lifted their Stage 1 Fire Restrictions, allowing unrestricted fire use; no county-level restrictions are reported in the area.
- No active wildfires are burning in or near Montrose-area counties; the only new large incident in today's national sit report (Foot Creek, Wyoming) is outside this region.
